voice.notes: adult male, ~110-135 Hz, casual US 'buddy explaining a fun fact' tone, fast (230-290 wpm), almost no pauses (longest 0.3 s), slightly amused on the myth line, deadpan on the twist

image_prompt: Photorealistic wildlife photo, vertical 9:16, {subject}, centred full-body, natural habitat background with soft depth of field, even daylight, high detail fur, the animal faces the camera; then add flat 2D cartoon overlay eyes: big white circles with thick black outline and black pupils, thick black cartoon eyebrows, expression {expression}

image_edit_prompts.eyes: Replace the animal's eyes with flat 2D cartoon eyes (white circles, thick black outline, black pupils) and thick black cartoon eyebrows showing {expression}; keep the photo otherwise unchanged
image_edit_prompts.tear: Add a small flat cartoon blue teardrop under one eye
image_edit_prompts.hand: Add a realistic human hand and forearm entering from the {edge} edge of the frame, {action} the animal
image_edit_prompts.human: A real photo of a {role} (body photoreal) with a flat 2D cartoon head: round skin-tone head, simple black line face, big cartoon eyes, {expression}
image_edit_prompts.bubble: Add a white cartoon thought bubble with black outline above the animal containing {content}
image_edit_prompts.silhouette: Turn the animal into a solid black silhouette, its lower part filled flat yellow like a battery level gauge, same background
image_edit_prompts.xray: Cartoon flat anatomy overlay (pink intestines / organ) drawn on the animal's belly, the fur still visible around it

video_prompt: Subtle natural motion of the animal (breathing, head tilt, chewing), camera locked, keep cartoon eyes fixed on the face
music_prompt: Light quirky curious underscore, minor key (A/C/D/G minor), 110-140 bpm, pizzicato and soft plucks with light percussion, no vocals, loops cleanly, playful-mysterious documentary-for-kids feel

kicks.use: on impact / surprise words (NOPE, crash, slap, a prop slamming in), 1-3 per video

edit.beats: new image every 1.3-1.7 s; within a shot swap to an edited copy (new eye expression / prop / hand) on the key word with a hard cut, so eyes and props change on the beat

animation.eyes: procedural (layers type eyes) over the real animal eyes; key on every 1-3 words, jitter darts ~0.55 s, auto blinks
animation.bases: generate the animal photoreal WITH its natural eyes (no cartoon), big in frame; image_model gemini-nano-banana-2.1
animation.props: generate each prop on flat pure green #00FF00, cut with vidclone.cutout, animate in with pop/slide_*

limits: Animals themselves do not walk or run (only the camera, props and eyes move); a running animal needs an ai-video clip
The samples move cut-out animals across the frame (running dog, walking panda); stills-motion can only fake this with pans or short ai-video clips (ElevenLabs creative_generate_video) per shot
Image models redraw fur and backgrounds between edits; keep each animal's edits chained from one base image and check eye placement on every frame
Caption fill is solid orange; the samples use a yellow-to-orange vertical gradient with a thin shadow, which ASS cannot draw as-is
